hooks.interfaceCode:
; Carregar dados do cliente
7000	set sc=$$ObterDadosCliente^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,CODPED,$piece(WDOMTESTEPVPD,Z,7),.DADCLIPED)
if $$$ISERR(sc) set DADCLIPED=""
set NOMCLI=$piece(DADCLIPED,Z,1),RAZCLI=$piece(DADCLIPED,Z,2),CNPCLI=$piece(DADCLIPED,Z,3),ENDCLI=$piece(DADCLIPED,Z,4)
set BAICLI=$piece(DADCLIPED,Z,5),CEPCLI=$piece(DADCLIPED,Z,6),CIDCLI=$piece(DADCLIPED,Z,7)
set LIMCLI=$$LimiteDisponivel^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,$piece(WDOMTESTEPVPD,Z,7))
quit
;
; Habilitar dados do cliente só quando não há código
7010	if $piece(WDOMTESTEPVPD,Z,7)'="" do DisableCp^%CSW1UTI("cp1100,cp1200,cp1300,cp1400,cp1500,cp1600")
if $piece(WDOMTESTEPVPD,Z,7)="" do EnableCp^%CSW1UTI("cp1100,cp1200,cp1300,cp1400,cp1500,cp1600")
do Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1100",NOMCLI),Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1200",RAZCLI),Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1300",CNPCLI),Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1400",ENDCLI)
do Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1500",BAICLI),Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1600",CEPCLI),Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1700",CIDCLI)
do Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1900",LIMCLI)
quit

fields.valcpCode:
if {reference}="" set sc=$$ObterProximoPedido^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,.{reference}) if $$$ISERR(sc) do ME^%CSUTICSP(sc) quit 0
do Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp{label}",{reference})
do Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"{display}",$select($data(^WDOMTESTEPVPD(1,CE,1,{reference})):$$NumeroPedido^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,{reference}),1:"Novo pedido"))

set sc=$$VerRepresentante^CCFTRG001(CE,{reference},.FTRE)
if $$$ISERR(sc) do ME^%CSUTICSP(sc) quit 0
set sc=$$ValidarRepresentanteUsuario^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,{reference},$$VEROP^%CSUTIUD(1))
if $$$ISERR(sc) do ME^%CSUTICSP(sc) quit 0
do Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"{display}",$piece(FTRE,Z,1))

if {reference}'="" set sc=$$VerCliente^CCFTRG001(CE,{reference},.FTCL) if $$$ISERR(sc) do ME^%CSUTICSP(sc) quit 0
do 7000,7010

if {reference}="" do ClearCp^%CSW1UTI("{display}") quit $$$OK
set sc=$$VerTransportadora^CCAPLRG001({reference},.CSTR)
if $$$ISERR(sc) do ME^%CSUTICSP(sc) quit 0
do Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"{display}",$piece(CSTR,Z,1))

buttons.actionCode:
set sc=$$ConfirmarPedido^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,CODPED)
if $$$ISERR(sc) do ME^%CSUTICSP(sc) quit
do MECABECALHO^%CSW1UTI("Pedido confirmado!")
set WDOMTESTEPVPD=$get(^WDOMTESTEPVPD(1,CE,1,CODPED)),TABALT(CODPED)=""
do 5000
quit

set sc=$$EnviarPedido^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,CODPED)
if $$$ISERR(sc) do ME^%CSUTICSP(sc) quit
do MECABECALHO^%CSW1UTI("Pedido enviado para o Consistem!")
set WDOMTESTEPVPD=$get(^WDOMTESTEPVPD(1,CE,1,CODPED)),TABALT(CODPED)=""
do 5000,8000
quit

ruleHooks.saveCode:
set sc=$$ValidarPedidoEditavel(codEmpresa,codPedido)
if $$$ISERR(sc) quit sc
if $piece(wdomtestepvpd,Z,3)="" set $piece(wdomtestepvpd,Z,3)="R"
set sc=$$GravarComplementoPedido(codEmpresa,codPedido,wdomtestepvpd,$get(NOMCLI)_Z_$get(RAZCLI)_Z_$get(CNPCLI)_Z_$get(ENDCLI)_Z_$get(BAICLI)_Z_$get(CEPCLI)_Z_$get(CIDCLI))
if $$$ISERR(sc) quit sc
ruleHooks.afterSaveCode:
set sc=$$FinalizarGravacaoPedido^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,CODPED,$select($get(FLGNOVO):"Novo",1:"Editar"))
if $$$ISERR(sc) do ME^%CSUTICSP(sc) quit
set WDOMTESTEPVPD=$get(^WDOMTESTEPVPD(1,CE,1,CODPED))
do 5000
ruleHooks.interfaceCode:
; Mostrar data/hora e status da capa
5000	set DATHOR=$select($piece(WDOMTESTEPVPD,Z,6)'="":$zdate($piece(WDOMTESTEPVPD,Z,6),4),1:$zdate(+$horolog,4))
set STAPED=$$DescricaoStatus^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG($piece(WDOMTESTEPVPD,Z,3))
do Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1100",DATHOR),Set^%CSW1UTI(%PRG,"cp1200",STAPED)
if $piece(WDOMTESTEPVPD,Z,3)="I" do ME^%CSUTIUD("Pedido indeferido pelo comercial: "_$$ObservacaoIndeferimento^WDOMTESTEPV100ARG(CE,CODPED))
quit
